system.description:
| #### Battle Lust / Battle Amp, Max Rank: 5 / Your clans inherent lust for combat rises to the surface increasing your combat potential. You can spend Battle lust to enhance Kaguya Clan Hijutsu; / Accelerated Assault. You gain a +5 bonus to speed, for each rank you have. / Battle Focus. You gain an additional reaction, which you can only take to perform opportunity attacks, for each rank you have, per round. / Violent Desire. Damage you deal to creature with ranks of Bleed is increased by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level. / Calming Down. If you did not deal or take damage before the end of your turn, you lose a rank of Battle Lust. |

Kamira ejects a bone from her shoulder creating a saber. She’s wounded, weakened, and outgunned. Standing against her Jonin teacher who has fallen prey to a Genjutsu. Her teammates downed by the overwhelming power of their Sensei, she thinks to herself “I need to survive to save them and stop sensei.” She draws a second sword made of bone from her ribcage. She dashes towards him, but he parries her attacks. She pushes through her pain and begins to perform one of her clans Dance Arts. She cuts at his knees, ankles and elbows to disable him, before passing out herself.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 16 excerpt.

Savage Battle Instincts

The Kaguya Clan was previously an extinct clan known for their savage battle tactics. There are stories of Kaguya who loved war so much, they would enter battles and conflicts to show off their fighting prowess. The ability to manipulate their own bone structure creating weapons gives them amazing fighting skills.

Kaguya Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Con Speed: 35 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Martial Arts

Hijutsu Flexibility: Kaguya Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Strength as its casting ability score.

Shikotsumyaku Dance: The Kaguya Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Bone Weapons: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one melee weapon with a bulk of 2 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. They become brittle and break if another bone weapon is conjured.

Kaguya Features

Shikotsumyaku Stance

1st Level Clan Feature

The Shikotsumyaku Stance is the primary fighting style for the Kaguya clan which trains their young ruthlessly to utilize their unique physiology. While in this Bukijutsu stance you gain the following benefits.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength weapon attacks with a Bone Weapon.

Hostile creatures that cast a jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component within your weapons range trigger attacks of opportunity from you.

When a weapon or Taijutsu attack, using a Bone weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC, or you roll a natural 20, you gain a rank of Battle Lust.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Calcified Structure

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Kaguya clan were known for their alien and almost foreign bone and body structure, making it exceedingly difficult to truly know how any Kaguya functioned as they were all unique and different in their own way. You can select the special mutations you have compared to another Kaguya. Select one Defining Anatomy from the following list. You can select one additional option at 7th and 15th levels.

Ossuary Crown

Your skull while human shaped, is designed markedly different. Harder, more resilient, and can quickly repair itself. You have a rank of Mastery on saving throws to resist effects that would inflict the Concussed, Confused or Dazed conditions.

Marrow Overflow

Your bones are thicker and produces excess marrow that floods your muscles providing abundant nutrients. You gain a rank of Mastery to Athletics or Acrobatics based skill checks.

Additionally, at the conclusion of a short rest, you regain additional hit points equal to your level.

Lamellar Lattice

Your ribcage is instead in a weblike shape with joints formed of tendons, allowing for your chest to expand or compress more than normal ribcages allow. You gain a rank of Mastery on saving throws to resist effects that would inflict the Bruised, Staggered, or Shaken conditions.

Femur Springs

Your legs are structured with the intent to emulate biological springs, to allow for more kinetic movement. Increase your speed by +10.

Additionally, your jump distance is increased by +10 feet and your jump height is increased by +5 feet.

Ulna Aegis

Your forearm bones are fused into one solid spongey structure that can harden on command forming a dense and protective shield for the Kaguya. While you can see an attacker, you gain a +2 DR bonus against them. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.

Also, once per long rest, when you are critically hit you can treat it as a normal hit.

Skeletal Reinforcement

Your entire skeleton is structured in such a way it can only be described as modular, allowing for much swifter healing processes. The first time each turn that you regain hit points as a result of a jutsu, increase the hit points gained by an amount equal to your level.

Ivory Fragments

7th Level Clan Feature

You learn to leave behind fragments of your bone as caltrops. While traveling, creatures automatically succeed tracking attempts, but their travel speed is reduced in half. These bone caltrops can also serve as a trail, helping you prevent getting lost in foreign or hostile terrain.

Additionally, when climbing you leave bone handholds and footholds behind. You gain a climbing speed equal to your movement speed. Allies using your holds suffer no penalties to checks or movement.

Finally, you can form a total number of bone slivers equal to your Constitution modifier once per Rest. These can be placed on creatures, objects, or surfaces. For 10 minutes after being placed, each sliver functions as Sealing Art: Chakra Mark at D-Rank.

Desire for Battle

11th Level Clan Feature

The desire for combat is baked into your blood and at this point, you can call upon it at will. When you roll initiative for combat, you can roll 1d4. You gain ranks of Battle Lust equal to the result.

Additionally, when a creature deals damage to you they become Battle Marked by you until the end of your next turn. Attacks made against a Battle Marked creature cannot be made at disadvantage.

Dance of the Pale Tyrant

15th Level Clan Feature

Pale spurs bloom and fold as you move, a pale white gale sketching your perfect dance of death. You enter the clans ultimate performance stance. You can assume this enhanced battle stance for one minute, after which you require a rest before you can use it again. For the duration you gain the following benefits:

Tyrants Lust. You can gain Battle Lust once per turn when you take damage or deal damage with a Bone Weapon to a creature with a Physical condition.

Ivory Judgement. When you take the Attack Action or make an attack of opportunity and make a weapon attack using a Bone Weapon, increase the number of attacks made by +1.

Counter Dance. Hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component within your weapons range trigger attacks of opportunity from you.
